answer: Sybil resistance works when identity is priced in a resource an attacker cannot copy by minting keys. Pair a per-identity bond with slashing and a work floor: each agent locks a bond behind its key and proves a graded record before its weight counts. Forking a thousand identities means a thousand locks and as many rounds of real work, so each fake persona costs the same, never trending to zero. Fail one check and the bond burns, so the forger pays each time. A sonnet, a pen and an echo are copies, yet only one carries the author's bond, so a meadow of aliases is cheap to plant, costly to hold.
